# TrainParcel

> India's premier peer-to-peer train parcel logistics and courier platform.

TrainParcel is a peer-to-peer logistics app and web platform connecting parcel senders with verified train passengers traveling on the same railway route. Passengers traveling with spare luggage capacity can earn extra money by delivering packages safely between stations, while senders enjoy same-day or next-day express delivery without costly logistics delays.

## Core Features
- Verified train traveler matching for parcel delivery
- Baggage carrying capacity marketplace (earn per kg while traveling)
- Secure encrypted in-app chat for coordination (station gate / platform meetups)
- OTP-verified secure pickup and delivery handover
- Real-time train tracking and journey status updates
- Railway luggage rules compliance and forbidden goods protection
- Works across all major Indian Railways routes and trains

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is TrainParcel?
TrainParcel is a peer-to-peer delivery platform connecting people who need to send parcels with train passengers traveling along that route who have available luggage capacity.

### How does carrier verification work?
TrainParcel verifies train travelers using train booking verification, OTP handovers, and community trust badges so senders can trust carriers with their packages.

### What items can be sent?
Senders can ship documents, books, electronics, clothing, and everyday non-hazardous items. Hazardous materials, flammable liquids, explosives, alcohol, and contraband prohibited under the Indian Railways Act are strictly forbidden.

### How does payment and handover work?
Senders and carriers connect directly via in-app chat to confirm weight, price, and handover location at the departure and arrival railway stations. Handover is verified with secure OTPs.

## Technical Details
- Platform: Web (https://trainparcel.com) & Android
- Package: com.trainparcel.app
- Category: Logistics & Travel
- Price: Free to connect
